title: 휴가 신청: 팀장님, 연차 좀 써도 될까요?
objective: Ask for annual or half-day leave and use -(으)ㄴ 다음에.
summary: Learn how to ask your manager for annual leave.
setting: An office. An employee goes to the team leader's desk to ask for annual leave next month.

task.title: Use what you learned
task.line: Change the verb, choose the right word, put words in order, or write a sentence, using the dialogue and word list.

words.meaning: Do you have a moment? (polite way to start talking to a boss)
words.example: 부장님, 잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요? 드릴 말씀이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Do you have a moment? There's something I need to tell you.

words.meaning: annual paid leave (also used for a single day of it)
words.exampleMeaning: I took a day of annual leave this Friday.

words.example: 병원에 가야 해서 오후 반차를 썼어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I had to go to the hospital, so I took the afternoon off.
You have to hand in the request form by tomorrow.

words.meaning: handover of work to a coworker
words.example: 휴가 가기 전에 인수인계를 꼼꼼히 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I did a careful handover before going on leave.

words.meaning: to approve (a document, as a manager)
words.exampleMeaning: The team leader hasn't approved it yet.

dialogue.meaning: Team leader, do you have a moment?

dialogue.korean: 다음 달에 연차를 좀 쓰고 싶어서요. 15일부터 19일까지요.
dialogue.meaning: I'd like to take some annual leave next month, from the 15th to the 19th.
Don't you have a presentation before that?

dialogue.korean: 네, 발표는 12일이에요. 발표가 끝난 다음에 쉬려고요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, the presentation is on the 12th. I plan to take time off after it's over.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 휴가 동안 일은 어떻게 해요?
dialogue.meaning: Then what about your work while you're on leave?

dialogue.korean: 민수 씨한테 인수인계를 한 다음에 갈게요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll go after I hand my work over to Minsu.

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 시스템에 휴가 신청서를 올린 다음에 말해 줘요. 바로 결재할게요.
dialogue.meaning: Good. Let me know after you put the leave request form into the system. I'll approve it right away.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to -(으)ㄴ 다음에: ① 서류를 (복사하다) ____ 팀장님께 드릴게요. ② 이메일을 (읽다) ____ 답장할게요. ③ 출장에서 (돌아오다) ____ 휴가를 갈 거예요.
Choose the right expression: ① 오전에 은행 일을 보고 오후에 출근하고 싶어요. (연차 / 반차)를 써요. ② 팀장님이 바빠 보여요. 말을 걸 때 먼저: (잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요? / 바로 결재할게요.)
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 결재를 받아요 / 휴가 신청서를 / 쓴 다음에
Join the two parts into one sentence with -(으)ㄴ 다음에: 이번 달 마감이 끝나다 + 연차를 쓰고 싶어요.
answers: ① 복사한 다음에 ② 읽은 다음에 ③ 돌아온 다음에
① 반차 ② 잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요?
휴가 신청서를 쓴 다음에 결재를 받아요.
이번 달 마감이 끝난 다음에 연차를 쓰고 싶어요. (이번 달 마감이 끝난 다음에 연차를 쓰고 싶습니다.)
